r.g.t-c.jyhad:

Could we please stop replying to spam on this newsgroup?
If you must reply, please reply to the author (and just to
the author) of the spam.

Spam is bad enough without multiplying the number of
useless messages on the group by posting follow-ups.

Thank you for your kind consideration (and for making
my job easier),
Scott
